richiami.difetto: The rear axle can become overloaded and the vehicle may become unstable when driven with a full load.  (Too many passenger seats on the off side of the vehicle).
richiami.rimedio: Remove two passenger seats and reposition others to balance load.

richiami.difetto: Loss of Traction on the front drive axle when vehicle fully loaded
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and adjust rear axle loading
richiami.titolo: UNEVEN LOADING CAN RESULT IN LOSS OF TRACTION ON DRIVE AXLE
